newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Bank Negara 91-day bills average yield 6.547 pct.
newsitem.headline: Bank Negara 91-day bills average yield 6.547 pct.

text.p: Malaysia's central bank said it accepted bids at an average yield of 6.547 percent at its auction of 91-day Bank Negara bills for 500 million ringgit.
At its previous auction on December 17 for one billion ringgit, Bank Negara accepted bids at an average yield of 6.632 percent.
The bids accepted were in the high/low range of 6.576/480 percent against 6.683/545 percent previously.
At its auction of 30-day Bank Negara bills for 500 million ringgit, the central bank accepted bids at an average 6.56 percent against 6.529 percent on January 7.
The bids accepted were in the high/low range of 6.593/510 percent against 6.544/495 last week.
Payment for both issues is on Wednesday.
